title: Vague reschedule with two appointments — clarify which one
caller_goal: Move 'my appointment' when the caller actually has two on the books.

script.content: Hey, I need to push back my appointment. Can you bump it to later in the week?
Happy to help with that. I see you have a facial on Tuesday and a laser session on Thursday — which one would you like to move?
Oh, right — uh, just whichever, it doesn't matter, just move it.

expected_intake_fields.notes: Which of the two appointments is being moved must be pinned down.

success_criteria: Pins down which specific appointment to move rather than guessing when the caller says 'whichever'.
Confirms the target appointment and a preferred new time before treating the change as done.
must_not_claim: An appointment was moved without establishing which one.
The reschedule is confirmed without an actual new slot.

failure_traps.description: Proceeds without establishing which of the two appointments to move.
Claims an appointment was rescheduled without confirming which one or securing a new slot.

notes: Synthetic. Multi-turn disambiguation; the agent must not resolve ambiguity by guessing.
